_comment: GitHub repos tracked for releases (what shipped). The host AI checks each repo's latest release/tag via agent-reach's gh channel, dedupes via scripts/state.py (so a release is never reported twice), and runs discovery_queries via `gh search repos` to surface new-to-you tools. last_stars feeds the long-term history log only — it is not a brief signal. Edit freely for your field.
_discovery_note: gh search repos ANDs every term — keep queries to one short phrase plus a stars: qualifier, or they return zero.
